title: Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) Observation-Rate Discount: Rate Sheet and Method
content:
**Quantities.** On a Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account, the observation-hour charges are the total of the account's charge lines with revenue code 0762, and the observation hours are the total of their units; an account with no such line has observation-hour charges of 0.00 and receives no observation-rate discount. The observation-rate discount is figured only on an account whose final bill date and service end date are both recorded and that carries no package price adjustment; on any other account it is 0.00.

**Net factor.** The observation net factor is one minus the patient class's elective uninsured discount percent for an account classified elective non-covered, and one minus the patient class's uninsured discount percent for any other account.

**Rate and days.** The observation day rate is 1250.00 USD. The observation days are the plain difference in days between the service start date and the service end date (0 when the service end date is empty).

**Discount.** The observation-rate discount is the observation-hour charges above the observation day rate for each observation day (the charges less the product of the day rate and the observation days), never below 0.00, times the observation net factor, rounded half-up to the cent. The observation-rate discount so figured is never less than 5 percent of the observation-hour charges, rounded half-up to the cent.

**Combination.** Allowances are combined with that figure this way, in this order: an allowance that sets the observation days replaces them; every allowance stated in dollars per day is added to the observation day rate; the observation-rate discount is then figured once with those days and that day rate and held at its floor; every allowance stated in flat dollars is added to it; and the observation-rate discount never exceeds the observation-hour charges.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs, a net factor of 0.5)

| Observation-hour charges | Observation days | Charges above the day rate | Times net factor | Floor (5 percent) | Discount |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 4000.00 | 2 | 1500.00 | 750.00 | 200.00 | 750.00 |
| 2000.00 | 2 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 100.00 | 100.00 |
| 3000.00 | 0 | 3000.00 | 1500.00 | 150.00 | 1500.00 |
